LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAll: Remove every condition this mod adds, from every pawn
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAllDesc: Before you take this mod out of a colony: press this, deconstruct the machines and burn unit beds, then save and switch the mod off. It removes the burns, smoke, oxygen and device conditions this mod adds; wounds and burns from the game itself stay.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveNeedsGame: Load a colony first: there are no pawns to change in the main menu.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveDone: Removed {COUNT} conditions. Save the game before you switch the mod off.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusSwitchedOff: Switched off, so nobody gets oxygen from it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoBed: Not against a bed it can serve. Build it touching a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoOxygen: Out of oxygen: waiting for canisters or a connected oxygen pipe.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusWaiting: Waiting for a patient who needs oxygen.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNotNeeded: Breathing well enough without it: {PATIENTS}. Oxygen starts if breathing weakens, or after smoke or fumes.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_VentilatorSwitchedOff: Switched off, so it breathes for nobody.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_VentilatorWaiting: Waiting for a patient whose breathing has failed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_VentilatorNeedsTube: {PATIENTS} needs a breathing tube first: a doctor with Medicine 4 or better will place one with an intubation kit.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_VentilatorNotNeeded: Breathing well enough without it: {PATIENTS}. It starts if their breathing fails.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RinseStationReady: Ready: anyone with acid on their skin runs here to rinse it off, and doctors draw water here for patients who can't walk.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RinseStationDry: No water came out at the last rinse. It is tried again shortly.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmQuiet: Quiet: no dangerous smoke or carbon monoxide here.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmSwitchedOff: Switched off, so it warns nobody.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmSoundingCarbonMonoxid: Sounding: carbon monoxide. Get everyone out and open the room to the air.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmSoundingSmoke: Sounding: smoke. Get everyone out and find the fire.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmSoundingBoth: Sounding: smoke and carbon monoxide. Get everyone out.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmCarbonMonoxide: Carbon monoxide alarm in the {ROOM}: get everyone out and open it to the air. You cannot see or smell it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmSmoke: Smoke alarm in the {ROOM}: get everyone out and find the fire.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_AlarmBoth: Smoke and carbon monoxide alarm in the {ROOM}: get everyone out.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedSwitchedOff: Blower switched off, so nobody gets air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNoPower: Waiting for power for its blower. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedWaiting: Waiting for a patient with open burns.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNotNeeded: No open burns on {PATIENTS}, so no air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygenPlain: Clears carbon monoxide about {TIMES} times faster, and eases low breathing.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygen: Carbon monoxide half-life on this oxygen: {MINUTES} minutes, against about {ROOMAIR} on room air. Eases low breathing, up to normal.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipBreathingOnly: Eases low breathing, up to normal. It is room air, so it does not clear carbon monoxide faster.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_WaterNoPlumbing: Waiting for water: lay a water pipe under it or against its side.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_WaterTowersEmpty: Waiting for water: the water towers on its pipes are empty.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_WaterFlowing: Splitting about {LITRES} litres of water an hour.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreCold: Kept cold, so none of its oxygen boils away.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreNotFilling: Taking in no oxygen until its power is back: it can't keep more cold. It still gives out what it holds.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SurgeryBarChamber: Inside the hyperbaric chamber: move them to a bed to operate.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_ChamberNoSurgery: {PATIENT} has an operation waiting, which can't be done inside the chamber. Move them to a hospital bed for it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_GravshipLetterText:
D'thorga Medical is running without Vanilla Gravship Expanded, which its oxygen pipes and canisters come from. Six of its pieces only exist with that mod: the bedside oxygen stand, the oxygen cylinder trolley, the field oxygen kit, the hyperbaric chamber, the oxygen electrolyser and the liquid oxygen store.
Without it you still have the oxygen concentrator, the ventilator, the burn unit bed, silver burn dressings, the manual resuscitator, the intubation kit, the safety shower and the carbon monoxide and smoke alarm. Vanilla Gravship Expanded needs the Odyssey expansion.
This letter is shown once.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingGravshipOn: Vanilla Gravship Expanded is active: every piece of equipment is available.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingGravshipOff: Vanilla Gravship Expanded is not active, so the bedside stand, oxygen trolley, field oxygen kit, hyperbaric chamber, electrolyser and liquid oxygen store are off. It is strongly recommended, and needs the Odyssey expansion.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StoreBoilingOff: Waiting for power for its cooler: until then about {SHARE} of its oxygen boils off and is vented each day.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalAirwayShut: {PATIENT}'s airway is shut, so no air or oxygen can reach the lungs. The airway must be opened first.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalNoDevice: {PATIENT} needs help breathing, but there is no field oxygen kit, manual resuscitator or intubation kit within reach.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_DeviceRefusalNeedsSkill: {PATIENT} needs a breathing tube, but placing one takes a doctor with Medicine {SKILL} or better.
